name: "Analyze"
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
      - "release/v*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "main"
      - "release/v*"
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
env:
  CODEQL_EXTRACTOR_CPP_BUILD_MODE_NONE: 'true' # scanning c/c++ without building it is an experimental feature and needs to be enabled like this until released
jobs:
  codeql:
    runs-on: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 'macos-latest') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      packages: read
      actions: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - language: c-cpp
            build-mode: none
          - language: javascript-typescript
            build-mode: none
          - language: python
            build-mode: none
          - language: java
            build-mode: none
          - language: actions
            build-mode: none
    steps:
      - uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1
        with:
          secrets_to_redact: '["${{ github.token }}"]'
        env:
          OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: '${{ secrets.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT }}'
          OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS: '${{ secrets.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS }}'
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.32.4
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.32.4
        with:
          category: "/language:${{matrix.language}}"
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1
        with:
          secrets_to_redact: '["${{ github.token }}"]'
        env:
          OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: '${{ secrets.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT }}'
          OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS: '${{ secrets.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS }}'
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6.0.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Lint code
        uses: super-linter/super-linter@v8.5.0
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: true
